# BPST Edu (BPST Software Education)

> BPST Edu is a software and IT training institute in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, India — the educational division of BitProSoftTech Software Solutions, led by Director Ankit Sahay. It offers 58 practical courses (classroom in Lucknow and live online across India) with live projects, Agile team sprints, mentorship by working IT professionals and job assistance (no placement-guarantee claims).

## Key facts
- Address: 3rd Floor, Sahay Complex, Near IIM Tiraha, Mubarakpur, Lucknow – 226013, Uttar Pradesh, India (near IIM Tiraha)
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 82991 01616 · Alt: +91 63946 36206 · Email: bitprosofttech@gmail.com
- Open: Monday – Saturday
- Modes: classroom (Lucknow) and live online (all India)
- Formats: 45-day crash course, 3-month program (recommended), 6-month industry program; language courses in Basic/Advanced levels
- Diwali 2026 offer: pre-book a seat in any course for ₹49 until 8 November 2026, 23:59 IST; the ₹49 is adjusted in the course fee. Book: https://edu.bitprosofttech.com/prebook.html
- Audience: school students (Class 3–12), B.Tech, BCA, MCA, Polytechnic/Diploma students, graduates of any stream and working professionals

## Industrial Training
Industrial training at BPST Edu, Lucknow is hands-on software training where students build and deploy real projects in Agile teams. You choose one of nine tracks — Full Stack, Advanced UI, Data Analytics, AI/ML, Generative AI, Cloud & DevOps, Cyber Security, Mobile Apps or Game Development — in a 45-day, 3-month or 6-month format, classroom or live online.
- Category page: https://edu.bitprosofttech.com/industrial-training.html
- [Software Development & Full Stack (.NET + React)](https://edu.bitprosofttech.com/courses/full-stack-development.html): 45 Days · 3 Months · 6 Months; Beginner friendly. From Fundamentals to Real-World Applications.
- [Advanced UI Development (Angular & React)](https://edu.bitprosofttech.com/courses/advanced-ui-angular-react.html): 45 Days · 3 Months · 6 Months; Beginner friendly. Craft High-Performance, Enterprise Web Experiences.
- [Data Analytics & Data Science](https://edu.bitprosofttech.com/courses/data-analytics-data-science.html): 45 Days · 3 Months · 6 Months; Beginner friendly. From Raw Data to Real Decisions.
- [Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning](https://edu.bitprosofttech.com/courses/artificial-intelligence-machine-learning.html): 45 Days · 3 Months · 6 Months; Beginner friendly. Learn Intelligence. Build Real Solutions..
- [Generative AI & Agentic AI](https://edu.bitprosofttech.com/courses/generative-ai-agentic-ai.html): 45 Days · 3 Months · 6 Months; Beginner friendly. Create | Automate | Augment | Build the Next AI Era.
- [Cloud Computing & DevOps](https://edu.bitprosofttech.com/courses/cloud-computing-devops.html): 45 Days · 3 Months · 6 Months; Beginner friendly. Build | Deploy | Scale | Power the Digital World.
- [Cyber Security & Ethical Hacking](https://edu.bitprosofttech.com/courses/cyber-security-ethical-hacking.html): 45 Days · 3 Months · 6 Months; Beginner friendly. Learn | Protect | Defend | Build a Safer Digital Tomorrow.
- [Mobile App Development (Android & iOS)](https://edu.bitprosofttech.com/courses/mobile-app-development.html): 45 Days · 3 Months · 6 Months; Beginner friendly. Build Apps. Shape the Future..
- [Game Development (Unity + C#)](https://edu.bitprosofttech.com/courses/game-development-unity.html): 45 Days · 3 Months · 6 Months; Beginner friendly. Play. Create. Build Careers..

## AI & Generative AI
BPST Edu offers five AI courses in Lucknow and live online: Agentic AI Engineering, Generative AI for Everyone (prompt engineering, no coding), MLOps/LLMOps, an AI specialization and a Machine Learning specialization. Courses run 4 weeks to 5 months and every learner builds a working AI project.
- Category page: https://edu.bitprosofttech.com/ai-generative-ai.html
- [Agentic AI Engineering](https://edu.bitprosofttech.com/courses/agentic-ai-engineering.html): 3 – 5 Months; Intermediate. Build AI agents that reason, use tools and get work done.
- [Generative AI for Everyone (Prompt Engineering)](https://edu.bitprosofttech.com/courses/generative-ai-for-everyone.html): 4 – 8 Weeks; Beginner. Use ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini & Copilot to work 10× smarter — no coding.
- [MLOps & LLMOps](https://edu.bitprosofttech.com/courses/mlops-llmops.html): 3 – 6 Months; Advanced. Take ML and LLM models from notebook to production.
- [Artificial Intelligence (AI + Generative AI)](https://edu.bitprosofttech.com/courses/artificial-intelligence-specialization.html): 4 Months; Python basics required. Specialization program.
- [Machine Learning](https://edu.bitprosofttech.com/courses/machine-learning-specialization.html): 4 Months; Python basics required. Specialization program.

## Data Analytics & Engineering
BPST Edu teaches data skills at two levels: Data Analyst Pro (Excel, SQL, Power BI, Tableau, Python — 3 to 4 months, beginner friendly) and Data Engineering (PySpark, Databricks, Snowflake, Airflow — 3 to 4 months, SQL required). Both include capstone projects on real datasets.
- Category page: https://edu.bitprosofttech.com/data-analytics-engineering.html
- [Data Analyst Pro (Excel + SQL + Power BI + Tableau + Python)](https://edu.bitprosofttech.com/courses/data-analyst-pro.html): 3 – 4 Months; Beginner friendly. From raw data to business decisions.
- [Data Engineering (Spark, Databricks, Snowflake, Azure/AWS)](https://edu.bitprosofttech.com/courses/data-engineering.html): 3 – 4 Months; Intermediate. Build the pipelines every data team depends on.

## Cloud & DevOps
BPST Edu runs cloud and DevOps training in Lucknow and live online: DevOps + SRE + Terraform (3–4 months), Google Cloud Engineer (6–8 weeks) and short certification bootcamps for AZ-900, AZ-104, AWS Cloud Practitioner and AWS Solutions Architect Associate. All courses are lab-based on real cloud accounts.
- Category page: https://edu.bitprosofttech.com/cloud-devops.html
- [DevOps + SRE + Terraform](https://edu.bitprosofttech.com/courses/devops-sre-terraform.html): 3 – 4 Months; Intermediate. Automate, deploy and run software at scale.
- [Google Cloud (GCP) Cloud Engineer](https://edu.bitprosofttech.com/courses/google-cloud-engineer.html): 6 – 8 Weeks; Intermediate. The third big cloud — BigQuery, GKE and Vertex AI.
- [Cloud Certification Bootcamp (AZ-900, AZ-104, AWS CCP, AWS SAA)](https://edu.bitprosofttech.com/courses/cloud-certification-bootcamp.html): 3 – 6 Weeks per exam; Beginner → Intermediate. Short, exam-focused cloud certification prep.

## Cyber Security & Networking
BPST Edu offers four security courses: SOC Analyst (blue team, 2–3 months), Ethical Hacking & VAPT with CEH preparation (2–3 months), Cloud Security for AWS/Azure (6–8 weeks) and CCNA + Network Security (2–3 months). Each is lab-based and maps to an industry certification.
- Category page: https://edu.bitprosofttech.com/cyber-security.html
- [SOC Analyst (Blue Team)](https://edu.bitprosofttech.com/courses/soc-analyst.html): 2 – 3 Months; Beginner → Intermediate. Detect, investigate and respond to cyber attacks.
- [Ethical Hacking & VAPT (CEH Preparation)](https://edu.bitprosofttech.com/courses/ethical-hacking-vapt.html): 2 – 3 Months; Beginner friendly. Think like an attacker, defend like a pro.
- [Cloud Security (AWS & Azure)](https://edu.bitprosofttech.com/courses/cloud-security.html): 6 – 8 Weeks; Intermediate. Secure identities, networks and workloads in the cloud.
- [CCNA + Network Security](https://edu.bitprosofttech.com/courses/ccna-network-security.html): 2 – 3 Months; Beginner. Networking fundamentals every IT career needs.

## Full Stack Development
BPST Edu offers full stack developer courses in MERN + Generative AI, Java (Spring Boot + React), Python (Django + React) and .NET (ASP.NET Core + React), plus a Golang microservices add-on. Programs run 4–6 months and end with a deployed full stack project and interview preparation.
- Category page: https://edu.bitprosofttech.com/full-stack-programming.html
- [MERN Full Stack + Generative AI](https://edu.bitprosofttech.com/courses/mern-full-stack-genai.html): 4 – 6 Months; Beginner → Advanced. MongoDB, Express, React, Node — with AI built in.
- [Java Full Stack (Spring Boot + React)](https://edu.bitprosofttech.com/courses/java-full-stack.html): 5 – 6 Months; Beginner → Advanced. The most-hired stack in Indian IT services.
- [Python Full Stack (Django + React)](https://edu.bitprosofttech.com/courses/python-full-stack.html): 5 – 6 Months; Beginner → Advanced. One language for web, data and AI.
- [Golang Microservices](https://edu.bitprosofttech.com/courses/golang-microservices.html): 6 – 8 Weeks; Intermediate. Fast, cloud-native back-ends in Go.

## Software Testing & QA
BPST Edu teaches software testing in three formats: Manual Testing (6 weeks, no coding), Automation Testing with Selenium & Playwright (2–3 months) and the complete Software Testing Masters program (3–4 months) covering manual, automation, API testing, JIRA and CI/CD.
- Category page: https://edu.bitprosofttech.com/software-testing.html
- [Software Testing Masters (Manual + Selenium + Playwright + API)](https://edu.bitprosofttech.com/courses/software-testing-masters.html): 3 – 4 Months; Beginner → Advanced. Complete QA engineer program — manual to automation.
- [Manual Software Testing](https://edu.bitprosofttech.com/courses/manual-software-testing.html): 6 Weeks; Beginner. The easiest entry into an IT job — no coding.
- [Automation Testing (Selenium + Playwright)](https://edu.bitprosofttech.com/courses/automation-testing-selenium-playwright.html): 2 – 3 Months; Intermediate. From manual tester to automation engineer.

## SAP, Salesforce & Enterprise IT
BPST Edu offers enterprise platform training: SAP S/4HANA FICO, SAP MM/SD and SAP ABAP (2–4 months each), Salesforce Admin + Developer with Agentforce (6–10 weeks), ServiceNow Admin + Developer (6–10 weeks), UiPath RPA + agentic automation (6–8 weeks) and Oracle SQL + PL/SQL (6–8 weeks).
- Category page: https://edu.bitprosofttech.com/sap-salesforce-enterprise.html
- [SAP S/4HANA FICO](https://edu.bitprosofttech.com/courses/sap-s4hana-fico.html): 2 – 4 Months; Beginner → Intermediate. Finance & Controlling on SAP S/4HANA.
- [SAP MM & SD (Materials Management + Sales & Distribution)](https://edu.bitprosofttech.com/courses/sap-mm-sd.html): 2 – 3 Months; Beginner → Intermediate. Procure-to-pay and order-to-cash on S/4HANA.
- [SAP ABAP on S/4HANA (RAP, CDS)](https://edu.bitprosofttech.com/courses/sap-abap-s4hana.html): 2 – 3 Months; Intermediate. Develop modern SAP applications.
- [Salesforce Admin + Developer (with Agentforce)](https://edu.bitprosofttech.com/courses/salesforce-admin-developer.html): 6 – 10 Weeks; Beginner → Intermediate. The world's #1 CRM — now with AI agents.
- [ServiceNow Admin + Developer](https://edu.bitprosofttech.com/courses/servicenow-admin-developer.html): 6 – 10 Weeks; Beginner → Intermediate. IT service management on the Now Platform.
- [RPA with UiPath + Agentic Automation](https://edu.bitprosofttech.com/courses/rpa-uipath-agentic-automation.html): 6 – 8 Weeks; Beginner → Intermediate. Automate office work with bots and AI agents.
- [Oracle SQL + PL/SQL](https://edu.bitprosofttech.com/courses/oracle-sql-plsql.html): 6 – 8 Weeks; Beginner → Intermediate. Database skills banks and enterprises rely on.

BPST Edu offers career courses beyond coding: Digital Marketing + AI (3–4 months), UI/UX Design with Figma (3–4 months), Business Analyst with Agile (2–3 months), AI Product Management (2–3 months) and Tally Prime + GST + Advanced Excel (1–3 months). Each includes portfolio or practical assignments.

## Programming Languages
BPST Edu teaches C, C++, Java and Python in Lucknow and live online. Each language has a Basic level (1.5–2 months) and an Advanced level (1.5–2.5 months); you can take one level or both. Classes are practical, with daily coding and a small project per level.
- Category page: https://edu.bitprosofttech.com/programming-languages.html
- [C Programming Course (Basic & Advanced)](https://edu.bitprosofttech.com/courses/c-programming-course.html): Basic 1.5 Months + Advanced 1.5 Months; Basic → Advanced. Foundation language.
- [C++ Programming Course (Basic & Advanced)](https://edu.bitprosofttech.com/courses/cpp-programming-course.html): Basic 2 Months + Advanced 2 Months; Basic → Advanced. OOP & competitive coding.
- [Java Programming Course (Basic & Advanced)](https://edu.bitprosofttech.com/courses/java-programming-course.html): Basic 2 Months + Advanced 2.5 Months; Basic → Advanced. Enterprise & Android.
- [Python Programming Course (Basic & Advanced)](https://edu.bitprosofttech.com/courses/python-programming-course.html): Basic 1.5 Months + Advanced 2 Months; Basic → Advanced. AI, data & automation.

## School Coding & Robotics
BPST Edu teaches coding to school students in Lucknow and online: Python foundations (Class 9–10), CBSE Computer Science with Python (Class 11–12), ICSE/ISC Java (Class 9–12), an Engineering Head-start in C/C++ after boards, and Robotics, Coding & AI for Grades 3–12.
- Category page: https://edu.bitprosofttech.com/school-coding.html
- [Robotics, Coding & AI for Kids (Grades 3–12)](https://edu.bitprosofttech.com/courses/robotics-coding-ai-for-kids.html): 3 – 6 Months per level; Beginner (levelled). Build robots, games and AI projects.
- [Coding Foundations with Python](https://edu.bitprosofttech.com/courses/python-coding-class-9-10.html): 3 Months; Beginner · no coding needed. Class 9 – 10.
- [Computer Science with Python (CBSE)](https://edu.bitprosofttech.com/courses/cbse-computer-science-python-class-11-12.html): Full academic year · per class; Board syllabus + beyond. Class 11 – 12 · CBSE.
- [Computer Applications & Science with Java](https://edu.bitprosofttech.com/courses/icse-isc-java-computer-applications.html): Full academic year · per class; Board syllabus + beyond. Class 9 – 12 · ICSE / ISC.
- [Engineering Head-start: C, C++ & Problem Solving](https://edu.bitprosofttech.com/courses/engineering-headstart-c-cpp.html): 2 Months (summer / post-boards); Beginner → Intermediate. Class 11 – 12 · Any stream.

## College Programs
BPST Edu runs year-wise career tracks for B.Tech, BCA, MCA and Polytechnic students. You pick modules per semester — programming, web, data, cloud or AI — and finish with an internship or industrial training certificate and interview preparation.
- Category page: https://edu.bitprosofttech.com/college-programs.html
- [B.Tech Career Track](https://edu.bitprosofttech.com/courses/btech-career-track.html): Pick per semester / year; 1st year → Final year. B.Tech · CS / IT / ECE.
- [BCA Career Track](https://edu.bitprosofttech.com/courses/bca-career-track.html): Pick per semester / year; 1st year → Final year. BCA.
- [MCA Industry Track](https://edu.bitprosofttech.com/courses/mca-industry-track.html): 3 / 6 Months (flexible); Intermediate → Advanced. MCA.
- [Polytechnic Diploma Track](https://edu.bitprosofttech.com/courses/polytechnic-diploma-track.html): 45 Days / 3 Months; Beginner → Intermediate. Polytechnic · Diploma CS / IT / ECE.

## Career & Placement Readiness
BPST Edu prepares students for placements with two programs: DSA & Placement Prep (2–3 months: data structures, 300+ problems, aptitude, mock interviews) and the Job-Readiness Program (1 month: communication, resume, LinkedIn/Naukri, mock interviews). Job-readiness modules are included with every industrial training track.
- Category page: https://edu.bitprosofttech.com/career-placement.html
- [DSA & Placement Preparation](https://edu.bitprosofttech.com/courses/dsa-placement-preparation.html): 3 Months; Any one language required. Specialization program.
- [Job-Readiness Program (Communication, Resume, Mock Interviews)](https://edu.bitprosofttech.com/courses/job-readiness-program.html): 1 Month · 3 sessions/week; All levels. Included with Industrial Training · also available standalone.

## Summer & Winter Training
BPST Edu summer training runs May to July and winter training runs December to January. It is a 45-day, project-based program in any of our tracks — Full Stack, Python, Java, Data Analytics, AI, Cloud, Cyber Security, Mobile or Game Development — with a training certificate.
- Category page: https://edu.bitprosofttech.com/summer-winter-training.html
- [45-Day Summer / Winter Industrial Training](https://edu.bitprosofttech.com/courses/summer-winter-training-45-days.html): 45 Days; Beginner friendly. Summer: May – July · Winter: December – January.

## Certificates & student portal
- Every BPST Edu certificate (course completion, industrial / summer-winter training, internship or project letter, staff experience letter) has a unique number such as BPST-C-2026-0187 and a QR code.
- Anyone can check a certificate: https://edu.bitprosofttech.com/portal/pages/public/verify-certificate.html (short link: https://edu.bitprosofttech.com/verify.html?no=CERTIFICATE-NUMBER)
- Enrolled students, trainers and staff sign in at https://edu.bitprosofttech.com/portal/ (classes, attendance, fees and GST receipts, ID card, certificates, payslips).
